_notes: Stage 6 DRAFT written by UX Designer UX-006-10 at 2026-10-03T14:17:39Z (UTC from code). It is NOT clean, NOT all of Stage 6, NOT a Stage 7 control and NOT owner approval. The owner liked the general style and gave direction on editor actions and profile identity only.

Claims: a row is claimed when its element is drawn in the screen files (D) or when it is a listed state, overlay or navigation shown by a named responsive or message pattern verified by a real export (P). Per-row D/P claims are recorded in .migration-tmp/stage-06/ux-006-01/manifest-claims-ux-006-07.json. Rows whose entry point is missing from the exports are not claimed: iteration-page 91, 98, 99, 210 and 192 (print view). App-shell rows were remapped onto drawn screens in UX-006-09 (19 projects-list, 185 task-page, 188 person-page, 192 iteration-page).

Provenance per file (screen ID, prompt key, SHA-256, PNG source) is in exports/ux-006-06/provenance.jsonl and result.md. API exports use the =w1600 size of the get_screen asset; official UI Export ZIPs: 827baa43…73a0 (list-desktop, form-desktop, dialog-desktop), 08308ffb…0fd4 (list-phone), 8f103662…172d (story-editor, task-page, task-delete-dialog, continue-dialog, time-editor, person-page, person-editor, aggregate-timesheet, note-editor, error-page, system-info, iteration-statistics-phone, ui-kit), 6157107c…a772 (time-editor-phone, form-phone).

Pending prepared entries (built automatically when their files exist): H4 (handoff-ux-006-09): extend iteration-page. Checked by content in the exported HTML: form-phone now shows Save, Reset and Cancel (ZIP 6157107c). Still NOT delivered: list-desktop and dialog-desktop (current files show 120.0 / 72.0 h, 40%, Story 1 Accepted; the ZIP 6157107c dialog candidate had corrected HTML but the old screenshot, so it was not imported) and form-desktop (no Reset). The authorized regenerations (UX-006-08) produced no obtainable new export. time-editor, person-editor and note-editor show Save and Cancel without Reset (prepared edits in prompts-ux-006-07-pending.json). continue-dialog-desktop: the dialog is correct, but its background page shows invented navigation (Projects, Iterations, Roadmaps, Reports, Create, help, notifications, settings) and invented story and customer names; this is a recorded defect, not counted as clean.

Editors (owner direction, relayed by Codex): Save, Reset and Cancel. Save stores and returns to the origin; Reset restores the initial values and stays; Cancel leaves without saving and returns to the origin. Neither replaces the other. Rows 81, 90, 125 and 139 record Update/Reset.

Profile (owner direction): initials avatar (avatar.initials) as identity and fallback on person-page (export pending A6). A photo is an explicitly unapproved extension that does not block the existing profile; no upload or identity integration.

Responsive patterns: list/table: priority columns, table scrolls in its own container, 44-48 px targets; verified by list-phone (a10e679d) and project-page-phone (f4a330e1); form: single column, 16 px fields, stacked full-width Save / Reset / Cancel; verified by form-phone (296b7803; Reset edit pending export) and signin-phone (c5d26872); dialog: full width minus 16 px, stacked 48 px buttons, scrim; verified by dialog-phone (fdb44f71); detail page: heading, stacked action buttons, summary, then list/table; verified by project-page-phone (f4a330e1); board: stacked status sections per story; verified by iteration-board-phone (58e255ee); messages and validation: error summary plus field errors; verified by form-phone and signin-phone; empty state: table.data empty row; NOT yet verified (component sheet A12 pending); charts: charts stacked one per row with text legends; NOT verified (A13 pending); time grid: one stacked block per entry; NOT verified (C pending); date picker on phone: NOT verified (no phone export of iteration-editor). Surfaces without their own phone export rely on these patterns and are not individually verified.

Navigation: per-screen navigation entries; breadcrumbs on hierarchical pages, none at the root (projects-list shows a root "Top" breadcrumb, a recorded deviation). Carrying list position in the URL is a proposal only.
Known CI issue (PM handles; exports not retouched): dead in-page anchors in form-phone, history-desktop, list-phone and projects-list-desktop.

Deferred: the 31 Stage 4 defer rows are recorded in the normalization deferred_rows field (UX-006-10, PR #48); they are not drawn. Former pending rows 161, 174, 189, 208 and 212 are placed (UX-006-09). The component sheet wireframes/ui-kit.html is the ui_design_system resource.
